text: API lets you programmatically book meetings and read/write scheduling, contacts, and notetaker data
quote: Programmatically book meetings and read and write Scheduling, Contacts, and Notetaker data.

text: Official MCP server brings scheduling actions into AI apps through natural conversation
quote: Bring scheduling actions into your AI apps through natural conversation, powered by Calendly MCP.

text: Personal access tokens are used to authenticate internal/private applications
quote: If you're integrating an **internal application** that only your team will use, authenticate with **personal access tokens**.

text: OAuth is used to authenticate public applications used by many Calendly users
quote: If you're integrating a **public application** that many Calendly users will use, authenticate with **OAuth**.

text: Natural-language commands are translated into structured API calls without writing raw REST requests
quote: It translates natural-language commands (e.g., "Book a 30-minute meeting with Sam next Tuesday") into structured Calendly API calls with no need to implement raw REST requests.

text: AI assistants/agents can book meetings end-to-end via the Scheduling API endpoint
quote: Enable AI assistants or agents in your product to **book meetings end‑to‑end** via Calendly's Scheduling API endpoint.

text: Webhook subscriptions deliver real-time payloads when meetings are scheduled or canceled by host or invitee
quote: When you [create a webhook subscription], payloads will be sent in real time to your server endpoint when events are scheduled or canceled by either the host or the invitee.

text: Provides an embeddable booking widget (inline/popup) via a JS snippet using an event or landing page link
quote: To initilize an **inline** embed, use `Calendly.initInlineWidget({url: myLink});`

text: Available meeting times can be shared from an external app to increase booking likelihood
quote: Effectively share available meeting times from an external application to increase the probability of meetings being booked and enhance the invitee experience.

text: Automatically looks up and matches known leads to assigned account owners from Salesforce and HubSpot
quote: Automatically look up and match known leads to assigned account owners from Salesforce and HubSpot.

text: Routing forms use fixed-answer logic to screen and qualify invitees before booking
quote: Create a routing form that uses basic routing logic (fixed answer responses) to screen and qualify people before they book with you.

text: Workflows automate pre- and post-meeting emails and texts to invitees, hosts, and teammates
quote: Use Workflows to automate pre- and post-meeting emails and texts to invitees, hosts, and teammates.

text: One-click reminder emails can be scheduled for invitees who haven't booked yet
quote: Schedule a reminder email in a single click, so recipients who haven't booked yet don't slip through the cracks.

text: Reschedule requests can be sent letting recipients pick a new time when plans change
quote: Send a reschedule request when your plans change and let recipients choose a new time.

text: Multiple calendars can be connected with buffers, custom schedules, and daily booking limits
quote: Connect multiple calendars and fine-tune your availability with meeting buffers, custom schedules, and daily limits.

text: Offers pre-built event types for common scheduling scenarios
quote: Calendly offers pre-built event types that make scheduling easy for everyone.

text: Team templates, admin controls, routing forms, and meeting distribution tools standardize scheduling
quote: Standardize scheduling with team templates, admin controls, routing forms, meeting distribution tools, and integrations that fold scheduling into existing workflows.

text: Meetings can be recorded with transcripts and shareable recap summaries
quote:
Recordings & transcripts
*   Shareable meeting recaps
*   Joins Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams

text: Automatically joins video conferences via Zoom, Google Meet, or Microsoft Teams
quote: Joins Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams

text: An AI assistant (Callie) can be added to an email thread to coordinate scheduling on the user's behalf
quote: Add Callie to any email thread to coordinate scheduling on your behalf without switching tools or sacrificing control.

text: Payment features let hosts charge upfront, sell packages, and send invoices at booking (Stripe/PayPal)
quote: Charge upfront for meetings, sell packages, and send invoices with payment features that make it easy to get paid.

text: Groups can coordinate time via scheduling polls or quickly created one-time meeting links
quote: Coordinate time with groups using polls or quickly spin up one-time meeting links.

text: MCP uses Dynamic Client Registration so no OAuth app pre-registration is needed
quote: Calendly MCP uses Dynamic Client Registration (DCR), which means **you do not need to pre-register an OAuth application**

text: REST API endpoint lets developers create new event types (POST /event_types)
quote: event\_types-create\_event\_type | Create a new event type | `POST /event_types`

text: Round-robin scheduling distributes meetings across a team
quote: Round-robin & team scheduling

text: Free signup via Google or Microsoft with no credit card required
quote: Sign up with Google Sign up with Microsoft ... No credit card required

text: Invitees can schedule from a website, LinkedIn, email, or elsewhere without manual coordination
quote: Make it easy for people to schedule from your website, LinkedIn, email, and beyond without extra steps or manual coordination.

text: Third-party forms can be imported to build custom routing routes from visible/hidden fields and Salesforce ownership status
quote: Import third party forms into Calendly and simply build scheduling routes from visible or hidden fields — as well as Salesforce ownership status.

text: Reports show conversion rates of scheduled meetings from Calendly, HubSpot, Marketo, or Pardot forms
quote: Report on conversion rates to see the percentage of scheduled meetings coming from Calendly, HubSpot, Marketo, or Pardot forms.

text: API supports building a custom 'Calendar View' for a given user
quote: Build a custom 'Calendar View' for a given user.

text: Calendars are synced so Calendly checks for conflicts before someone books time
quote: Sync your calendars so Calendly can check for conflicts before someone books time.

text: API can retrieve availability information for a specific event type
quote: Calendly users can retrieve information about availability for a specific event type

text: Scheduling link and booking page can be personalized for a polished experience
quote: Personalize your scheduling link and booking page for a more polished experience.
